formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Email delivery itself is unprotected, but track choice, route selection, rights, link permissions, content suitability and unpublished eligibility policies require human review.

activityVerification.evidence: FBi.radio's official site exposes a populated seven-day schedule, current program teams and current episodes. The Playlist published episodes through July 10, 2026, while M5 and Unfurl published episodes dated July 12, 2026. The station states that it has streamed online and broadcast on 94.5 FM since 2003.

genreFitEvidence: The current schedule includes global dance, contemporary club and bass music, experimental club, ambient, electronic, world and soul-oriented programs.
Deep Web explicitly covers emerging internet microgenres; Unfurl covers ambient and soundscapes; current presenter programming includes electronic, R&B, soul and reggae-adjacent selections.

Selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, ambient, experimental, world-fusion or reggae-adjacent material has plausible fit, subject to route-specific curation and the station's strong Sydney and Australian-music mandate.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is free and publicly authorized, but a human must select one appropriate contact, verify the exact stream and download assets, confirm rights, content, international eligibility, release timing and AI-origin policy, and send the email manually without duplicate servicing.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search was checked for the station name, official domain, general submission mailbox and canonical submission path. No existing music-submission-agent record was found before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: General Music Director servicing and current specialist-program alternatives are stored as one canonical platform opportunity. The same release must not be sent to multiple FBi.radio contacts.

notes: One new FBi.radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No email, audio, link, form, account, CAPTCHA, payment or promotional purchase was submitted.
